title: Average 401(k), IRA balances hit record highs — but more workers are raiding their accounts, Fidelity says
summary: Fidelity reports that average balances in 401(k) and IRA retirement accounts have reached unprecedented levels in the second quarter, primarily due to favorable market conditions. However, this positive trend is accompanied by an increasing number of workers withdrawing funds from their retirement savings. The dual trends highlight a growing concern about financial security as more individuals prioritize immediate cash needs over long-term savings. This situation raises questions about the sustainability of retirement savings in the face of economic pressures. As market gains bolster account balances, the urge to access these funds may undermine future retirement readiness.
